scenes.title: Nick Fury Appears
scenes.description: Nick Fury arrives at Tony Stark's home to discuss the Avengers Initiative, setting up the MCU's interconnected future.

scenes.title: The Pager
scenes.description: As people turn to dust, Nick Fury sends a distress signal on a modified pager. The screen shows Captain Marvel's symbol.

scenes.title: The Avengers Find the Pager
scenes.description: The remaining Avengers study Fury's pager when Captain Marvel suddenly appears, asking 'Where's Fury?'

scenes.title: No Post-Credits
scenes.description: Avengers: Endgame has no traditional post-credits scene. Instead, you hear the sound of Tony Stark forging his first armor from Iron Man.

scenes.title: Identity Revealed
scenes.description: Mysterio's team releases doctored footage revealing Spider-Man's identity as Peter Parker to the world.

scenes.title: Skrulls Revealed
scenes.description: Nick Fury is revealed to be Talos the Skrull, while the real Fury commands a Skrull ship in space.

scenes.title: Venom in the MCU
scenes.description: A piece of the Venom symbiote is left behind in the MCU after Eddie Brock returns to his universe.
